summary_en: Kindensha tender offer for Kodensha shares completed. Offer results and changes to major shareholders and related parties disclosed.
title_en: Notice of Completion of Public Tender Offer for Company Shares by Kindensha Co., Ltd., and Notification of Changes in Principal Shareholders and Other Related Parties
translation_en_brief: The disclosure reports the completion and results of a public tender offer (公開買付け) by Kindensha Co., Ltd. (きんでん) for shares of The Kodensha Co., Ltd. (弘電社). This is a take-private transaction in which Kindensha, the acquiror, has tendered for and acquired Kodensha shares with the goal of making Kodensha a wholly-owned subsidiary. The notice simultaneously discloses changes in Kodensha's principal shareholders and related parties resulting from the tender offer completion. Specific offer terms (price per share, total consideration, share acceptance details, and settlement date) and the final acceptance count are not visible in the provided excerpt and would appear on subsequent pages of the full disclosure.
